messages:
mike.h: EDR alert -> WIN-LAPTOP-23 (amy.t). Outbound to 185.199.108.153 flagged as known C2, process 'weirdupdater.exe' quarantined. Host isolated by EDR. Ticket INC-20250315-842.

edr-bot: Action taken: quarantine process, network isolation (host-group: isolated), full AV scan started, memory snapshot requested.

sara.k: Copy. @amy.t are you currently using that machine? Any recent third-party installs or privileges changes?

amy.t: Not at my desk right now. I did install a vendor debugging tool last week (DevHelper.exe) for a build. No admin installs since. Will hand it over.

jt-ops: I'll start a remote pull of the EDR logs and an L1 triage. Can someone paste the agent logs and recent netconns? Run this on the host if you can:

```powershell
Get-NetTCPConnection | Where-Object {$_.State -eq 'Established'} | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,RemoteAddress,RemotePort
```

mike.h: From EDR quick report (snippet):

```
[2025-03-15T14:02:12Z] process: C:\Windows\Temp\weirdupdater.exe PID 12940 -> 185.199.108.153:443 (domain: badcollector.example) flagged: C2 fingerprint match 0.87
[2025-03-15T14:02:17Z] action: quarantine file, block network, isolate host
[2025-03-15T14:05:03Z] memory snapshot saved -> /forensics/WIN-LAPTOP-23/mem-20250315-1405.bin
```

sara.k: Good. We need a forensic image and memory preserved. I'll coordinate courier for device pickup (corp asset recovery). Also request cloud KMS access logs for any keys used by amy.t in the last 48h. Possible lateral/tokens?

amy.t: I'll revoke active sessions and rotate any keys I touched. Which keys should I rotate?

mike.h: Start with dev-deploy-key and staging-service-key. Also revoke short-lived tokens issued in the last 24h. @jt-ops can you check IAM assume-role logs and recent console logins for amy.t?

jt-ops: Running CloudTrail query now: output snippet below.

```
2025-03-14T23:12:01Z - AssumeRole: arn:aws:iam::1111:role/dev-builder by amy.t (session: SESS-3421)
2025-03-15T09:44:23Z - ConsoleLogin: Success - amy.t via SAML from corp-sso
2025-03-15T10:12:47Z - Encrypt: kms:Encrypt -> dev-deploy-key by role/dev-builder
```

jt-ops: No suspicious cross-region key usage seen yet. Will dig deeper into KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls.

edr-bot: Full scan completed: 2 additional items quarantined -> suspicious-svc.dll, persistence-autorun.lnk. No network egress after isolation.

sara.k: Containment confirmed. Next steps: (1) Forensic image + triage (jt-ops), (2) Device custody & key rotations (amy.t), (3) RBAC review for dev-builder role (mike.h + infra), (4) Org-wide Yara scan for the DevHelper tool signatures limited to developer endpoints (security ops).

mike.h: Assigning owners: jt-ops -> forensic image + cloud logs, sara.k -> containment comms & SOC update, amy.t -> device custody + rotate keys, legal-bot -> compliance/notice. ETA for initial findings: 4 hours.

legal-bot: Noted. Preserve logs and evidence for 90 days. If PII or customer data exposure suspected, escalate to Legal immediately.

sara.k: Quick FYI for comms: No evidence of data exfil at time of isolation. Continue monitoring network traffic and S3/DB access patterns for amy.t role.

mike.h: Thanks. I'll update INC-20250315-842 with this plan and set a follow-up in 3h. :eyes:
